headline.en: Hand drip, one cup at a time

traits.zh: 招牌为手冲咖啡，每杯单独冲煮
traits.en: Specializes in hand drip, one cup at a time

traits.zh: 室内吧台配高脚凳，外摆6把黑椅4张圆桌
traits.en: Counter with high stools, 6 black folding chairs and 4 round tables outside

traits.zh: 营业至凌晨1点（周五至周六）
traits.en: Closes at 1 AM on Fridays and Saturdays

traits.zh: 空间紧凑，有吧台、纸灯笼与木质家具
traits.en: Compact space with counter, paper lanterns, and wooden furniture

traits.zh: 店内可见咖啡机与磨豆机，无烘焙设备
traits.en: Coffee machines and grinder visible, no roaster on site

focus.en: One barista, one kettle, wait required

linger.en: Requires waiting, not built for long stays
